events.418.title: Visigothic capital
events.418.text: Toulouse becomes the capital of the Visigothic kingdom. The city plays a major role in southwestern Gaul.
events.1218.title: The siege of Toulouse
events.1218.text: During the Albigensian Crusade, Toulouse resists the siege of 1217–1218. Simon de Montfort, leader of the crusaders, dies beneath the city walls in 1218. This period of warfare profoundly marks its history.
events.1229.title: Foundation of the university
events.1229.text: The University of Toulouse is founded in 1229. Teaching takes place across the city; there is not yet a single campus.
events.1348.title: The Black Death
events.1348.text: The Black Death reaches Toulouse in spring 1348. The CHU historical account estimates that about 15–30% of the population dies during the epidemic, through 1350. This is a retrospective estimate rather than an exact count.
events.1463.title: The great fire
events.1463.text: On 7 May 1463, a fire breaks out near rue Maletache. Fanned by the autan wind, it devastates much of the commercial heart of Toulouse.
events.1562.title: The Wars of Religion
events.1562.text: In May 1562, Catholics and Protestants clash in Toulouse. The violence results in the expulsion and massacre of Protestants. The city becomes a Catholic stronghold in a region where Protestants control many towns.
events.1628.title: The plague of 1628–1631
events.1628.text: A new plague epidemic strikes Toulouse from 1628 to 1631. The CHU historical account estimates about 10,000 deaths over this period from an initial population of 50,000, nearly one person in five. This estimate remains approximate.
events.1681.title: Inauguration of the canal du Midi
events.1681.text: The canal du Midi is inaugurated on 15 May 1681. It opens to traffic along its full route in 1684; the section between Toulouse and Castelnaudary had already operated since 1674.
events.1856.title: Arrival of the railway
events.1856.text: The station is inaugurated on 16 April 1856. The railway transforms travel and the Matabiau district.
events.1875.title: The great flood
events.1875.text: On 23 and 24 June 1875, a catastrophic Garonne flood strikes Toulouse, particularly Saint-Cyprien. The map from this period shows flooded areas and collapsed houses.
events.1917.title: The rise of aviation
events.1917.text: Pierre-Georges Latécoère establishes his factories at Montaudran in 1917. The site becomes a major landmark in Toulouse aviation history.
events.1993.title: The first metro
events.1993.text: Metro line A is inaugurated on 26 June 1993. It marks a new stage in travel across Toulouse.
